name: Virginia House of Delegates Page Program
org: Virginia House of Delegates, Clerk's Office
what_you_do: Work as a House Page for the whole 2027 legislative session in Richmond. Pages deliver documents and run errands. They help committees and the Clerk's Office. They also take part in leadership and civics training.
who_can_apply: Virginia youth who will be 13 or 14 years old on January 13, 2027. You must be in good school standing. Your school must agree to the long absence.
pay_detail: Paid, about 40 hours a week: a weekly expense payment plus a wage every two weeks. Amounts are not stated.
duration: The 2027 session. The page says 7 weeks in odd-numbered years
deadline_text: The 2027 application closed Oct 16, 2026 at 3 p.m. Look for the 2028 application in late summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply on the portal linked from the Page Programs page. Finish every part. Talk to your school first, since you will miss weeks of class. Questions: HousePageInfo@house.virginia.gov or (804) 698-1502.
notes: Pages live together and have a study hall each night. Not the Senate Page Program. 2028 dates not posted.
